ja291:1.1: A villain received a water jar that gave all that was desired,
ja291:1.3: As long as he protected it,
ja291:2.1: When, intoxicated and wanton, from heedlessness he broke the jar,
ja291:2.3: Then, being naked and poor, the fool afterwards suffered hardship.
ja291:3.1: So he who, having received wealth, being heedless makes use of it,
ja291:3.4: like the villain who broke the pot.
